purpose: Machine-checkable aggregate fixture for the public vLLM #51187 response-object-vs-token mismatch observation. This is not an independent reproduction.

source.comparison: all unordered repeat pairs across five byte-identical repeats

decision_relevance.safe_inference: For any frozen deterministic scorer that consumes only the emitted token/text sequence, the reported trace has zero scorer-input mismatch despite nonzero response-object/logprob mismatch. Thus full response-object equality would reject differences that are irrelevant to that scorer in this exact trace.
decision_relevance.not_safe_to_infer: This fixture does not establish token stability in other fingerprints or server lifetimes. The source itself reports a second server lifetime that was fully reproducible and does not identify a universal threshold.

contrast_source.observation: The merged fix for #51290 reports TP=4 produced 8 distinct bit-exact outputs over 8 identical runs before the fix and 1 after; mnnvl showed token flips and trtllm showed 8 distinct logprob groups with zero token flips in one reported run. This contrast is why the fixture must remain fingerprint-scoped.
